prompt: Hierarchical edge bundling explorer. Layout switcher: circle pack (d3.pack), treemap (d3.treemap), dendrogram, radial tree, sunburst, icicle. Bundle links with curveBundle and tension slider (default tension 0.85 so bundles are clearly visible). Toggle link visibility and link layer order. Click to select nodes, hover to highlight groups. Randomize dataset button — cross-fade new data using keyed .join() rather than removing and rebuilding DOM, so there is no blank flash. Use keyed .join(enter, update, exit) for all layout transitions so nodes interpolate smoothly between positions. Labels at least 11px; in radial layouts, hide labels that would overlap. Light background, high-contrast palette.
